item.title: Blizzard created severe blood shortage in state - Jamestown Press
item.description: The Rhode Island Blood Center has declared an emergency after 1,500 planned donations were canceled due to the Feb. 22-23 blizzard. People in Jamestown who want to help can donate from 11:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Tuesday, March 24, at the recreation center, 41 Conanicus Ave. Register through RIBC.org/ drives by using code 1385.
